name: Fluent Emoji High Contrast
about: Fluent Emoji High Contrast is a free, open-source icon set with 1,596 icons designed by Microsoft Corporation. From smileys and gestures to animals, food, activities and symbols, every emoji stays crisp at any size. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Fluent Emoji High Contrast free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,596 Fluent Emoji High Contrast are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How can I use Fluent Emoji High Contrast emoji on my website or app?
faqs.a: Copy any emoji as an SVG, PNG or WebP image, paste it as a React component, or drop the CDN link into your HTML. Because they are vectors, they stay sharp at any size – from tiny reactions to large illustrations.

faqs.q: Do Fluent Emoji High Contrast include skin-tone or gender variants?
faqs.a: Some emoji sets ship skin-tone and gender variants as separate icons. Search this set (try a specific emoji name) to see which variants are included here.

faqs.q: How many Fluent Emoji High Contrast are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,596 icons in the Fluent Emoji High Contrast set, designed by Microsoft Corporation. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Fluent Emoji High Contrast available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
